correctness.rationale: Invertible finite-abelian Fourier transform converts uv=vu into independent cyclic determinant equations. The explicit q^2-state 0/1 matrix of determinant-zero pairs has eigenvalues 0 of multiplicity (q+1)(q-2), q-1 of multiplicity q, and two roots of λ²-qλ-q(q-1); hence the exact cycle trace formula and unrestricted product count. Linear constraints on b for fixed a prove the stated exact run-wise centralizer dimension. Centralizing all b confines a to T-fixed characters, whose number is |ker(1-2φ)|. Distinct free parameters and cases m=1,2, all-zero/nonzero are checked in the proof. Direct finite checker returned VERIFY_OK but does not replace proof.

value.rationale: The number of commuting pairs and dimensions of each elementwise commuting centralizer are natural conjugacy-free invariants of finite nonassociative algebras; an exact all-group cycle formula is not a routine consequence of earlier Fourier product or image data. The complete finite-field probability and centralizer rule apply to arbitrarily large finite abelian groups, yield an explicit commuting-center dimension and group-endomorphism-cycle census, and distinguish these invariants from square-zero and zero-divisor questions. The determinant-incidence spectrum is an independent reusable structural counting device.
